tables: THE TWO LAW TABLES OF ADDENDUM 13 ARE RE-POINTED, NOT REPEATED. Their 1,075 bars and rows were re-classified on 2026-09-12 under the owner's re-cut: 434 were STRUCK OUTRIGHT and 287 more lost half their teeth, because they policed PERMISSION, TONE or CONSTRUCTION rather than truth. The four that most damaged the prose are gone entirely: W15's always-safe spelling list (thirty-one prescriptions that forced twelve renderings onto one approved noun), W24's record-word table, W20's layer bar and W22's person bar. DO NOT APPLY THEM FROM MEMORY. What survived is 179 contradiction rows plus 62 findings the conversion discovered, 44 of which are NEW BARS - and all of it lives in ONE file you read instead: rewrite/recut/CONTRADICTION-TABLE.md, which opens with the test in the refuter's own words and an explicit list of WHAT IS NO LONGER A FINDING. Read your desk's section of it and that header list. THE NEW BARS THAT BIND THE DEFENSE DESK, each measured from the engine and none of them stated by any old rule: a MILITIA and a WATCH are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE (exclusiveGroup 'civilianDefense'), so a town never has both as standing bodies; a Town watch is PART-TIME by its own catalogue row (the separate city row is Professional city watch), so a town watch is never professional, never full-time, never soldiers; EVERY CITY HAS A GARRISON (required true, professional soldiers, noble or royal), so no city is written without soldiers of its own and 'the garrison' off a town barracks never imports the city rung; there are FOUR upkeep gates on the defense page, not two, all monotone in econOutput, so no face splits their direction (never the watch paid and the muster not); the shortfall is BOUNDED on every gate and the unpaid community baseline is exempt, so the licensed extreme is short, late or thin and NEVER none; the occupation note runs the other way from the old bar, so an occupied town's own bodies are not swept away; the readiness band moves on tier and country while no works move, so a low band is never explained by the works' condition; and the town's printed AGE turns history into a live contradiction source, so age-flavour is free EXCEPT where it denies the printed age. THE FIVE CLOSED ROSTERS (floor 1): the institution roster over the LIVE roster, the force buckets (garrison, militia, watch, mercenary, charter), the faction list, the faith entries, the NPC office roster. A body, building, record-keeper, force or faith-house they do not carry may not be asserted. EVERY OTHER ABSENCE IS SILENCE, AND SILENCE IS PERMISSION.
rulings: WHAT WOULD BE FALSE ON DS-DEF-2 (the five threat rows; the block's own contradiction set under ADDENDUM 14). THE ENGINE MEANINGS, which are contradictions when read as English: plagued is MONSTER ACTIVITY and never disease; settled is the LOW monster-and-raider tier of the country (the stress roll multiplies siege and monster by 0.3) and never 'no live threat' and never the centre of a realm; frontier is the DEFAULT of an unmeasured town, so it is never read as a measured fact; 'perimeter' is FALSE of a Citadel (inner) and of Gates (a point), so the safe generic on those rows is the works or the recorded name; 'organized force' is the force BUCKETS and never 'the guard' (which is the power generator's FALLBACK label on a town whose safety profile prints 'no meaningful guard presence'); hasGranary is a TIER PROXY (every town-plus, no village-and-below) and says nothing whatever about the stock inside it; hasHospital fires on a first-level divine healer (a person) and on a monastery that MAY run one, so a house that takes in the sick is licensed only on a hospital-named row; hasChurch fires on every hamlet from a church in ANOTHER settlement and records parishes rather than care; hasCourtSystem is every town and city from a meeting hall (a civil arbitration is recorded, a criminal trial is not) and Small prison/stocks DOES hold cells; the readiness band word is exactly the ladder's reading and a badge on one arm says nothing of another; the economic-survival arm is FOOD-STORAGE-driven resilience and never prosperity. THE ALIAS CONTRADICTIONS: 'the garrison' only where a Garrison or Multiple garrisons row resolves (city tier), and where an occupation is on the page the face says whose; 'the watch' as a NAME only on a resolved watch row (town-plus), and never both a watch and a militia on one town; 'the militia' only where the militia row resolves. THE PAY GATE: one military purse over wall maintenance and garrison wages together, so a face never pays the wall and not the muster; the wall STANDS THROUGH a shortfall; the shortfall is bounded and never total. A slowly thinning muster is MODEL-TRUE and is no longer barred (ruling R-9), but a HEADCOUNT is DS-DEF-5's cell and stating one here collides with that surface. THE FOUR SHIPPED CLAUSES THAT ARE STILL FALSE and must not be carried forward: 'substantial works' (a magnitude no field holds - floor 2); 'how relaxed the people on it are' (manning asserted from a summary whose own fence says it asserts nothing about any arm); 'takes this town with ladders' (a prediction the simulation adjudicates, and an earth berm needs none); 'clergy who tend the sick' (hasChurch records parishes, not care). EVERYTHING ELSE THE SHIPPED ROWS SAY IS AVAILABLE TO YOU AGAIN - the old law struck many of those clauses for being unlicensed, and unlicensed is no longer a fault. THE PREIMAGE: four of this block's five rows are keyed on BOOLEANS, so one face prints across every tier, country and stress state the key admits; none of the five key functions reads config.stressTypes, so a face about a quiet gate can print under an ACTIVE SIEGE banner. Write nothing that a siege, an occupation or a famine on the same page would make absurd.
